'''Blackmoon PPD 15 - Biker Scout ROps''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Blackmoon]]
* '''Published:''' 25 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 ROps Blackmoon DS 2003 PPD15Bik.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

GPN members' take on a time-tested classic.

== Strategy ==

This design allows for a turn two flip.  Once the objective is flipped, pull Biker Scout Gear and start causing some serious havoc with your Speeder Bikes.  Thanks to everyone who participated!

I went ahead and added Thrawn to the sideboard, in case you wanted to put him on Chimaera, where he's at his best.
